title: AI-built apps: objects the AI creates get their colour tile — the AI service passes the blueprint's color to the object, as it already passes icon
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Split out of #35985 by the maintainer's decision (Sales, 2026-11-22 07:25Z: 「同意 35985」, which picked 「现在关卡，AI 带色另开卡」).

## What the user sees today

#35985 gave every object a colour, picked from a small fixed palette (`ObjectSchema.color`). The icon is drawn as a white glyph on a coloured rounded tile, the same in menus, titles, lookup chips and search (PRs #36012, #36042, #36089, all merged). An object a person creates by hand, or one declared in a package, shows its colour.

An app the AI builds does not: its new objects come out without a colour, so every tile falls back to the neutral face. The AI writes a `color` in its blueprint, but the step that turns the blueprint into objects passes `icon` and drops `color`. That step is in the AI service, not in this repository.

## What to do

- Wherever the AI service materialises a blueprint object, pass the blueprint's `color` through to `ObjectSchema.color`, exactly as it passes `icon`. A value outside the palette is dropped (the schema refuses it), not guessed.
- No platform change is expected here. If the AI service needs a platform hook, say so on this card first.

## Acceptance

- Ask the AI for an app with three new objects. The three objects show three different colour tiles in the app menu, on the record page title and on a lookup chip, matching the colours the blueprint chose.
- An object the AI creates with no colour still shows the neutral tile, unchanged.

Context: #35985 (closed by this split), #36099 (the CLI `os explain object` colour row, separate).
